title: The Goodwill Gesture a Traveller Club Tier Brings to a Cancelled Package
content:
Where a tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club carrying a package discount stands on a traveller's active club card, a goodwill gesture is added back to what is returned on a cancelled package of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products. The gesture is a share of the reduced withholding, and the lines already charged on the package ledger as an amendment, a name change or a date change decide how much of the tier's package discount that share comes to.

**No such line on the ledger.** Where an active club card stands in the traveller's name whose tier carries a package discount and the package ledger carries no line charged as an amendment, a name change or a date change — 0 of them — that tier's package discount of the reduced withholding is added back as a goodwill gesture.

**Such a line on the ledger.** Where an active club card stands in the traveller's name whose tier carries a package discount and the package ledger carries a line charged as an amendment, a name change or a date change — 1 or more of them — one half of that tier's package discount of the reduced withholding is added back as a goodwill gesture, that is 50 per cent of that discount.

**Otherwise.** Where no active club card stands in the traveller's name, or the tier on it carries no package discount, nothing is added back as a goodwill gesture under this note.

## Where the records are read

The card is the traveller's Wanderlane Traveller Club membership and it must be an active one; the package discount is the discount recorded against the tier standing on that card.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

Where the reduced withholding on a cancelled package comes to 1,020.00 USD and the traveller's active club card carries a tier with a package discount of 6 per cent, with no amendment, name change or date change line on the package ledger, the goodwill gesture is 61.20 USD.

The same package carrying 1 such line: the share is one half of the 6 per cent, being 3 per cent of the reduced withholding, so the goodwill gesture is 30.60 USD.
